title: 21st sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/21/2024).

Question time: Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir asks Minister of Climate Change, Environment and Energy Thoriq Ibrahim when the stalled B. Kendhoo powerhouse, started through Fenaka under the previous government, will be completed and brought into service.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Isdhoo MP Ismail Shafeeu.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill amending the Legal Profession Act (Law No. 5/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé North MP Hussain Shareef.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill amending the Employment Act (Law No. 2/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Kulhudhuffushi North MP Mohamed Dawood.
Report of the Public Finance Committee on its review of the President's nomination for Governor of the Maldives Monetary Authority, under Article 6(3) of the MMA Act (Law No. 6/81).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the energy minister on the Kendhoo powerhouse, debated the decentralisation amendment, continued the legal profession and employment bill debates and reviewed the MMA Governor nomination.
